name: K-C Beech Island Mill - Beech Island SC
type: Integrated tissue & personal care manufacturing complex (largest K-C facility globally)

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Old Jackson Hwy confirmed in Street View (2026-03): barrier arm across divided lanes, digital 'Beech Island' sign.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small guard booth with blue canopy in the median between inbound/outbound lanes, visible in both satellite z20 and Street View.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with divided 2-in / 2-out lanes plus landscaped islands; ample paved width to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the south face of the main building and a separate dock bank on the NE building cluster - physically separate clusters on a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Sprawling campus: ~7 distinct large building masses plus wastewater treatment ponds, all inside one fenced perimeter.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Honest estimate - 90+ doors across the south main-building face and the NE building; exact count not resolvable, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop yards: a long double row of angled trailers along the south dock apron and extensive rows in the north of the campus; 300+ trailers visible.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible from overhead; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the complex sits in farmland/forest near the small community of Beech Island, edge of the Augusta GA metro fringe.
